description: Real turbofan engine measurements including acoustic and vibration signals from two configurations under normal and faulty conditions

accelerometer_channels.note: Used for vibration analysis but not included in primary acoustic model

blade_pass_frequency.description: Blade Pass Frequency for engine speed monitoring

metadata.parameters_string: Sampling frequency =40960 Hz, Nombres de mesures =1654784
metadata.unity_description: t (s), micros (Pa), Accelerometres (g), top pale (V), Nfan (rpm), BPF (Hz)

important_notes: Normal and faulty data come from different engine configurations - classifier may learn configuration differences
This must be documented as a limitation in any results
Microphone channels are the primary acoustic modality for this analysis
Accelerometer data is available but treated separately for vibration analysis
Only 2 recordings per class - generalization evaluation must use group-aware splitting

scientific_caveats.confounding_variable: Configuration differences (2 vs 4) may confound fault classification
scientific_caveats.limited_data: Only 4 signal recordings total (2 normal, 2 faulty)
scientific_caveats.generalization: Generalization performance difficult to assess with limited independent runs
scientific_caveats.recommendation: Use group-aware evaluation (e.g., GroupKFold, LeaveOneOut) to prevent data leakage
scientific_caveats.disclaimer: Model accuracy may partially reflect configuration differences rather than pure fault detection ability
